The interface keeps research performance and clinical meaning separate.

01

Probability, not certainty

The largest of three averaged model probabilities determines the displayed class.

02

Local what-if view

Influence shows how confidence changes when one input is replaced by its dataset median; it is not causal.

03

Mid-risk caution

The champion recalled only 15.8% of mid-risk holdout cases, so intermediate patterns need particular caution.
